claims.text: Cromolyn nasal (OTC, adults and children 2 and older): one spray in each nostril 3-4 times a day (every 4-6 hours), up to 6 times a day if needed.
claims.quote: adults and children 2 years and older: spray once into each nostril. Repeat 3-4 times a day (every 4-6 hours). If needed, may be used up to 6 times a day.

claims.text: Preventive: start up to one week before allergen contact;
claims.quote: to prevent nasal allergy symptoms, use before contact with the cause of your allergies. For best results, start using up to one week before contact.

claims.text: the best effect may take 1 to 2 weeks.
claims.quote: Your best effect may not be seen for 1 to 2 weeks.
